notes.title: Patch Update Apr 4 2023
notes.content:
Patch Update April 4 2023
- Minor Bugs Fixed.
- Easier to escape after surrender.
- Taotan's Fire Storm will not hit a player if the player was down.
- Lumina's Hell Judgement will reduce Player's HP & MP by halve instead of make them to 1 in Casual Difficulty.
- Warrior will be invulnerable while using Crash Skill and Death Blow.
